records.scope: Entire javap display for TreeFloor and two iterators, no truncation or execution.
records.observation: TreeMap with supplied BufForObjects.Order comparator, depth short, mutable cached TimeBoundingBox; direction taken from increasing INDEX flag. Earliest/latest key selection swaps first/last for decreasing order, casts actual keys to TimeBoundingBox. getTimeBounds updates same cached object from endpoint keys only, not extrema across all members; logs unordered result then returns it. Empty maps fail firstKey/lastKey; no guard. covers/overlaps/disjoints refresh cache; coversBarely checks earliest key contains query start AND latest key contains query finish (inclusive contains inherited, verified directly in TimeBoundingBox.contains(double)). prune only enters when aggregate covers; until coversBarely, a failed earliest containment removes fixed TreeMap.firstKey and failed latest containment removes fixed lastKey. These removals do NOT reverse for decreasing comparator despite earliest/latest reversal, so can remove the opposite temporal edge. No empty guard or coverage recheck after removal: deleting wrong edge can eventually empty map and cause firstKey/lastKey exception. Exact final right endpoint is accepted by contains(double); no half-open endpoint defect is inferred. This is static conditional flow, actual caller order/query reachability pending TreeFloorList/TreeTrunk reading. Iterator factories forward flags. toStubString wraps keys in new BufStub and prints each; toString prints values in map order, null values fail. Map mutations inherited unrestricted; cached bounds returned directly. No archived execution.

records.observation: Captures timeframe and Drawable.Order references, nesting flag and composite flag. Compares drawable increasing TIME flag with floor increasing INDEX flag; copies floor values into new ArrayList in map order, shallow node references. Uses forward list iterator at0 when same direction, backward iterator atsize otherwise. Immediately prepares first group with nextObjGrpItr and setObjGrpItr, satisfying superclass initialization requirement. Advances node iterator then tests TreeNode.overlaps, skips nonoverlap; delegates to iteratorOfDrawables(timeframe,order,composite,nestable). Returns null on exhaustion; superclass hasNext skips empty groups and next requires normal hasNext discipline. Empty map safely produces empty iteration, unlike floor bounds methods. Later map membership changes do not affect copied list, but node objects/timeframe are shared and not frozen. No cross-node merge sorting, null/type guard, or overlap-gap repair. No archived execution.
